plannedPreloader.purpose: establish ownership before test module evaluation while allowing test-local env setup

findings: No unmocked non-loopback external call was found in the 67 current test paths.
Cloud Tasks, metadata, awareness SDK, and HTTP-like calls use injected fetchers, node:test fetch mocks, fixture callbacks, or local loopback servers.
30 tests assign a test-owned DATABASE_PATH before dynamic db import; the remaining tests may use the per-process fallback if their service path opens SQLite.
No direct static db.js import was found in the test files; transitive service imports remain dependent on the preloader establishing env first.
No executable skip/todo/only conditions were found.
stopIf: Any test path reaches a non-loopback URL through ambient globalThis.fetch rather than the listed seam.
config/db is imported before the preloader sets DATABASE_PATH, or readback shows the owner/default database path.

nonLoopbackNetwork.evidence: enqueue function receives fetchImpl; metadata and Cloud Tasks URLs are called only through that injected function.

entries.paidCallRisk: none observed; provider credentials/routes are test values and physical seams are mocked, injected, or not called.

database.evidence: No test-local DATABASE_PATH assignment found; if the service/repository path opens SQLite, it uses the per-process fallback path supplied by the planned preloader.

database.defaultDbRisk: no owner/default DB under stated preloader, but shared fallback contamination is possible
